summary: Phase 16 background-publish — 15/15 backend tests PASS. Verified return-immediately behaviour, idempotency (exactly one balance_transactions per label even on race re-publish AND on restart-resume), polling progresses to published+100%, all republish guards (already-published 400, processing 400, anon 401, release_admin 403), and the resume_interrupted_imports() startup hook moves a forcibly-stuck 'publishing' import to 'published'. Frontend data-testid attributes for status-publishing, publish-progress, error-banner, and publish/retry buttons are all present in RoyaltyDetail.jsx and correctly conditional on status.

minor.issue: Observed a perceived read-after-write race: balance_transactions reference label_ids that pymongo (separate client) cannot find immediately after publish — adding a fresh MongoClient + 1s sleep makes them appear. Likely Mongo default read-concern / connection-pool caching across motor (backend) vs pymongo (tests). Not a Phase 16 regression; flagged for awareness.

action_items: (Optional polish) Main agent may want to wire `/api/royalty/admin/imports/{id}/publish` to return HTTP 202 instead of 200 to better signal 'accepted, processing async' to clients — current implementation correctly returns immediately but uses 200.

(Optional) Background _publish_bg only $inc's label.balance_pending_idr — if the referenced label was previously deleted, the $inc silently no-ops but a balance_transactions row is still inserted (orphan tx). Consider a defensive existence check or upsert log. Pre-existing behaviour, not introduced by Phase 16.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/royalty.py is 1389 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting (e.g., admin_imports.py, label_reports.py, withdraw.py).

_publish_bg is correctly idempotent: existing balance_transactions check skips already-credited labels, bulk update_many on lines is naturally idempotent, notifications gated by the credited list. resume_interrupted_imports re-spawns _publish_bg for any 'publishing' status on startup. Solid implementation.
publish endpoint correctly returns the current doc when status='publishing' (idempotent race), 400 on 'published'/'processing'/'dana_received'. Auth gate is super_admin OR admin_finance only.
